No — for 8.5" × 11" paper you want **Letter** size, not A4. A4 is a European standard (210mm × 297mm / 8.27" × 11.69") which is slightly narrower and taller than Letter. Printing an A4 document on Letter paper (or vice versa) can cause slight clipping or scaling at the margins.

**Recommended printer settings for 8.5" × 11":**

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Paper Size | **Letter** (8.5" × 11") |
| Orientation | **Landscape** — the depreciation schedules are wide tables |
| Scaling | **Fit to Page** or **Shrink to Printable Area** |
| Margins | Narrow (0.25"–0.5") to maximize table width |
| Quality | Standard / 300 dpi is sufficient for text-heavy documents |

For the annotated PNG images I just sent, when printing those specifically, set scaling to **"Fit to Page"** in landscape orientation and they should fill the sheet cleanly.
